**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee exists anywhere in the Agreement:

- **§ 27.3** expressly lets Customer terminate "without penalty" with a refund of prepaid Fees.
- **§ 7.3** bars interest on amounts ultimately found not due.
- **§ 21.3** characterises undisputed Fees for conforming Services as a payment obligation, not damages.
- **§ 22.2** imposes only actual audit costs and an undisputed usage shortfall — not a stipulated sum.
- Termination provisions (§§ 9.1–9.5, 10.1–10.2) contain no exit fee, acceleration, or minimum-fee-on-termination mechanic.

The § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment is comparable economic exposure, but it is a minimum-volume commitment reviewed under the minimum-commitment rule; I have not double-flagged it here. No redline proposed.
